items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: Sidney Bessie, that was my inspiration. And I would try, as much as I could to play like him.

ctx.x: When you started playing, did you, the way you played, did it sound like anybody else? Did you want to play like anybody else, or just your own style, or what?
I didn't want to play like Sidney Bessie, that was my inspiration. And I would try, as much as I could to play like him. But I just couldn't get the tone.
Yeah. What, uh, you ever played tenor saxophone? Tenor? Oh yeah, I played tenor.
